args.title: Handle storage errors per key in purgeExpiredFailedUploads
args.body:
File: src/ingest/worker.ts

Wrap the storage.remove call in purgeExpiredFailedUploads in a try/catch block so that an AccessDenied or other storage error on a single object key does not abort the purge loop and prevent subsequent expired failed uploads from being deleted.
